newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-ZELIC ON LOAN AT RAPID VIENNA FOR ONE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZELIC ON LOAN AT RAPID VIENNA FOR ONE YEAR.

text.p: Australian midfielder Ned Zelic joined Austrian first division club Rapid Vienna on loan from French Club Auxerre on Thursday.
Rapid manager Stefan Ebner said the 1996 European Cup Winner's Cup finalists had provisionally signed Zelic for year.
Ebner said Zelic would be entitled to play in Saturday's league match against LASK Linz.
Zelic, 26, was formerly at Borussia Dortmund, Queen's Park Rangers and Eintracht Frankfurt before joining Auxerre a year ago.
On Wednesday, Bulgarian defender Trifon Ivanov, who played in the 1994 World Cup, left Rapid to join Austria Vienna.
